title: Popover
description: A click-triggered floating panel for interactive content such as filters or account menus, anchored to its trigger. Unlike Tooltip it holds focusable content and manages focus, Escape and outside clicks itself; inside a Modal it closes first.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state; leave `undefined` for uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state while uncontrolled

props.name: modal
props.description: Modal mode: traps focus inside the panel, locks page scrolling, hides the rest of the page from assistive technology and blocks outside pointer interaction (an outside click still closes it)

events.name: onOpenChange
events.description: Called with the requested open state (trigger, Escape, outside click, `PopoverClose`).

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges onto the single child element instead of rendering a `<div>`

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merges the behaviour onto the single child element instead of rendering a `<button>`

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side; flips when there is not enough room

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment along the trigger

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap to the trigger in pixels

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Skid along the trigger in pixels (positive = towards the end)

props.name: collisionPadding
props.description: Minimum distance kept to the viewport edges in pixels when flipping, shifting and sizing the panel

props.name: matchAnchorWidth
props.description: Sizes the panel after the trigger / anchor width: `"min"` at least as wide, `"exact"` exactly as wide (also caps the width to the viewport)

props.name: arrow
props.description: Renders an arrow pointing at the trigger

props.name: portal
props.description: Renders the panel into a portal (the theme-scoped container of a nested `ConfigProvider`, else `document.body`)

props.name: forceMount
props.description: Keeps the panel mounted while closed (`data-state="closed"`), e.g. for animation libraries

events.name: onOpenAutoFocus
events.description: Before focus moves into the panel on open; `event.preventDefault()` keeps focus where it is.

events.name: onCloseAutoFocus
events.description: Before focus returns to the trigger on close; `event.preventDefault()` skips it.

events.name: onPointerDownOutside
events.description: Pointer pressed outside; `event.preventDefault()` keeps it open.

events.name: onFocusOutside
events.description: Focus moved outside; `event.preventDefault()` keeps it open.

events.name: onInteractOutside
events.description: Pointer down or focus outside; `event.preventDefault()` keeps it open.

examples.title: Basic usage
examples.description: PopoverTrigger toggles the panel; focus moves inside and returns to the trigger on close. PopoverClose closes it. In a non-modal popover, Tab past the last element (Shift+Tab before the first) closes it and moves focus to the element after (before) the trigger; focus never loops inside.

examples.title: Controlled with an anchor
examples.description: open + onOpenChange control the state; PopoverAnchor positions the panel against another element.

examples.title: Placement
examples.description: side, align and sideOffset position the panel; it flips and shifts to stay in view. arrow points at the trigger.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: The trigger slot toggles an interactive panel; focus moves in and returns on close. Escape, an outside click or an element with data-popover-close closes it.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: side and align place the panel around the trigger, side-offset sets the gap and arrow points at it; it flips and shifts to stay in the viewport.

anchor.title: Anchor and modal
anchor.description: anchor positions the panel against another element (by id) while any button opens it with show(); modal traps focus and blocks the rest of the page.

props.label: Accessible name of the panel (or set aria-label on the element).
props.anchor: Id of the element (same tree) to anchor to.
props.anchorElement: Element the panel is positioned against instead of the trigger; takes precedence over anchor.

events.minerva-open-change: The user asked to open / close (detail: { open, reason }); cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current state.
events.minerva-after-close: Fired once the panel has finished closing (after its exit animation).

slots.trigger: Element that toggles the popover when clicked.

basic.title: Native example
basic.description: Interact with the native component in this phone preview.

native.limitations: On touch devices the content opens in a dismissible native dialog; DOM floating coordinates and hover positioning do not apply.
